title.narrative: EISA- Support to Mozambique electoral process 2018/2019 - EISA - REPAYMENT

description.narrative: Målet med programmet var en mer trovärdig valprocess 2018/2019 genom ett förbättrat engagemang av intressenter i processen. Målen skulle uppnås genom politiska partiers mer effektiva roll i styrning och valövervakning, en förbättrad rättslig och institutionell ram för val och ett starkare medborgerligt engagemang i valprocessen.

The objective of the program was a more credible 2018/2019 electoral process through improved engagement of electoral stakeholders in the process. The objectives was to be achieved through an effective role played by political parties in governance and election monitoring, an improved legal and institutional framework for elections, and stronger civic engagement in the electoral process.
